versions.content: The SW-Component template shall support implementation data type Type: valid Description: • Implementation types represent the data types communicated between SWCs and RTE. • It shall be possible to model all Service Interfaces with implementation types only. • It shall be possible to model AR debug variables with implementation types. • It shall be possible to use implementation types in port interfaces without needing application types. • It shall be possible to model all BSW Interfaces with implementation types. • An implementation type can be specified independently of any application types. Rationale: See [RS_SWCT_03215] Use Case: See [RS_SWCT_03215] Dependencies: [RS_SWCT_03215] Supporting Material: See [RS_SWCT_03215]
